en: Lance
{player}, over here. The signal's coming from somewhere on this floor.
The room it comes from is behind a pair of shutters, and they open only to a password. The grunts down here know it.
Get it out of them. I'll deal with the rest of their lookouts.
Grunt
The password? Don't look at me. They only tell it to the ones who guard the doors.
Grunt
Fine! The first half of the password is... 'Golden'. You won't get the other half, though!
Grunt
All right, all right! The other half of the password is... 'Persian'. Happy now?
A speaker beside the shutter crackles: 'Password?' {player} said both halves the grunts gave.
The shutter slid open!
The shutter is locked tight. A speaker beside it crackles: 'Password?'
{rival}
...You again. What are you doing in a dump like this?
Team Rocket. They act tough in a gang, but on their own every one of them is weak.
I'm going to be strong enough to take them all on alone. Don't get in my way.
Giovanni
So. You've made it this far. I am Giovanni, leader of Team Rocket, returned at last.
And you think you can stand against me? Then show me...
Petrel
Ha! Fooled you, didn't I? I'm Petrel, Team Rocket's master of disguise. The boss isn't here.
But you've seen my face now, so you're not leaving!
Petrel
Argh! All right, you win. The radio signal? It comes from the generator on the floor above.
But you'll never open the shutters to it. Only the boss's Murkrow knows that password!
Hey! Murkrow, come back! ...Oh, forget it. I'm out of here.
The Murkrow keeps croaking the same words over and over.
